description: Fork of exp732 (4K, val=1.3912 @ 276.8M). Single change: weight_dtype fp32 -> bf16 on every FastMultiHeadLUT module (qk_lut, v_lut, out_proj, residual_lut, emb_resid_lut). Tests whether bf16 master weights regress val_bpb vs fp32. Default n_outputs>=128 bmm-wgrad dispatch unchanged (FORCE_BMM_WGRAD env-var NOT set), isolating the weight-storage variable. Micro-benchmark shows -14.8% per-step wallclock at this config (v_lut +16% due to bf16 atomic-add, all other modules -25-35%). All other hyperparams identical to exp732: 4K steps, bs=24 ga=2 eff bs=48, Lion lr=2e-4 LUT, AdamW 3e-4 non-LUT, soft_score_temp=select_temp=0.5 learnable, soft_use_bf16=True (compute autocast unchanged). Expected wallclock ~62-65 min.
